question: 有效订单一共有多少笔？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM analytics.orders WHERE status IN ('paid','shipped','completed')

question: 取消订单有多少笔？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cancelled_orders FROM analytics.orders WHERE status = 'cancelled'

question: 各订单状态分别有多少笔？
gold_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM analytics.orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

question: 各地区有效订单数是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM analytics.orders WHERE status IN ('paid','shipped','completed') GROUP BY region ORDER BY region

question: GMV 总额是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount), 2) AS gmv FROM analytics.order_items oi JOIN analytics.orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid','shipped','completed')

question: 各商品类别的 GMV 是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT c.name AS category, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount), 2) AS gmv FROM analytics.order_items oi JOIN analytics.orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN analytics.products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN analytics.categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid','shipped','completed') GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY c.name

question: GMV 最高的五个商品是什么？
gold_sql: SELECT p.name AS product, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount), 2) AS gmv FROM analytics.order_items oi JOIN analytics.orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN analytics.products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid','shipped','completed') GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY gmv DESC, p.name LIMIT 5

question: 销量最高的十个商品是什么？
gold_sql: SELECT p.name AS product, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units FROM analytics.order_items oi JOIN analytics.orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN analytics.products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid','shipped','completed') GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY units DESC, p.name LIMIT 10

question: 各支付方式的支付订单数量是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT method, COUNT(*) AS payment_count FROM analytics.payments GROUP BY method ORDER BY method

question: 退款总金额是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0), 2) AS refund_amount FROM analytics.refunds

question: 各退款原因分别有多少次？
gold_sql: SELECT reason, COUNT(*) AS refund_count FROM analytics.refunds GROUP BY reason ORDER BY reason

question: 整体退款率是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.id), 0), 4) AS refund_rate FROM analytics.orders o LEFT JOIN analytics.refunds r ON r.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status IN ('paid','shipped','completed')

question: 各地区退款率是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT o.region, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.id), 0), 4) AS refund_rate FROM analytics.orders o LEFT JOIN analytics.refunds r ON r.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status IN ('paid','shipped','completed') GROUP BY o.region ORDER BY o.region

question: 有效订单的平均客单价是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id), 2) AS average_order_value FROM analytics.orders o JOIN analytics.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status IN ('paid','shipped','completed')

question: 各地区平均客单价是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT o.region, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id), 2) AS average_order_value FROM analytics.orders o JOIN analytics.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status IN ('paid','shipped','completed') GROUP BY o.region ORDER BY o.region

question: 每个获客渠道有多少客户？
gold_sql: SELECT channel, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM analytics.customers GROUP BY channel ORDER BY channel

question: 每个地区有多少客户？
gold_sql: SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM analytics.customers GROUP BY region ORDER BY region

question: 复购客户有多少人？
gold_sql: WITH customer_orders AS (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM analytics.orders WHERE status IN ('paid','shipped','completed') GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS repeat_customers FROM customer_orders WHERE order_count >= 2

question: 各月份的有效订单数是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('month', ordered_at), 'YYYY-MM') AS month, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM analytics.orders WHERE status IN ('paid','shipped','completed') GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', ordered_at) ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', ordered_at)

question: 各月份的 GMV 是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('month', o.ordered_at), 'YYYY-MM') AS month, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount), 2) AS gmv FROM analytics.orders o JOIN analytics.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status IN ('paid','shipped','completed') GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', o.ordered_at) ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', o.ordered_at)

question: 各月份的退款金额是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('month', refunded_at), 'YYYY-MM') AS month, ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS refund_amount FROM analytics.refunds GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', refunded_at) ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', refunded_at)

question: 净销售额是多少？
gold_sql: WITH sales AS (SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) AS gmv FROM analytics.order_items oi JOIN analytics.orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid','shipped','completed')), refund_total AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS refunds FROM analytics.refunds) SELECT ROUND(sales.gmv - refund_total.refunds, 2) AS net_sales FROM sales CROSS JOIN refund_total

question: 平均每笔有效订单有多少件商品？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity)::numeric / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id), 2) AS average_units FROM analytics.orders o JOIN analytics.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status IN ('paid','shipped','completed')

question: 折扣总金额是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.discount_amount), 2) AS discount_amount FROM analytics.order_items oi JOIN analytics.orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid','shipped','completed')

question: 各类别有多少个商品？
gold_sql: SELECT c.name AS category, COUNT(p.id) AS product_count FROM analytics.categories c LEFT JOIN analytics.products p ON p.category_id = c.id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY c.name

question: 商品平均标价是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(list_price), 2) AS average_list_price FROM analytics.products
